The front view punches four openings 3.54in [90] across and 1.42in [36] tall; a module's 108.97 plate covers its opening, its thumb-knobs landing in the pair of holes either side (3.91in, 99.4 apart on the panel drawings), and only the adapter block behind passes through. So each bay is the module plate's 108.97 x 35.05, centred on its opening, and `opening` is the hole an empty slot shows. Adjacent plates stand about 1.0 apart. every FHD cassette and adapter panel this library models is in every bay's `accepts`. FS states it on this datasheet's features list ('Compatible with all FHD cassettes and panels') and prints the same loading list with every one of them as fs/fhd-1ufce does; the module face is one 4.29 x 1.38in (108.97 x 35.05) envelope."},"chassis":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"spec table: 1.73 x 19.00 x 8.93in (44 x 482.6 x 227).
